basic_info.description: Stylish 1-bedroom in the heart of chic Jackson Square! This beautifully appointed luxury building was designed in 2018 by Handel Architects. A spacious elevator whisks you up to this elegant unit, featuring a double closet at the entry, high ceilings, and wide-plank oak flooring. A gorgeous open kitchen is designed with honed Taj Majal slab countertops and backsplash, dark veneer cabinetry by Studio Becker and contrasting brass fixtures. Equipped for the gourmet chef with a central island, Wolf cooktop, oven, and convection microwave, Asko dishwasher, and SubZero refrigerator. The kitchen is open to the living room and dining area, with almost floor-to-ceiling windows facing west to Battery Street overlooking treetop greenery. Down the hallway is a generous bedroom with double closet, and a sleek hall bathroom outfitted with Carrera marble, floating vanity, a shower over tub, and Waterworks brass fixtures. Luxury upgrades include in-unit laundry and central AC. This boutique LEED Gold building offers 2 rooftop terraces with spectacular views of the city, the Bay and the Bay Bridge, as well as 24/7 security and garage parking. Ideally located across from the Battery Club, central to shops and restaurants in Jackson Square, Bay Club Gateway, and the Embarcadero and Ferry Building.
